inputs.name: username
inputs.label: Username (with consent or a documented case basis)

legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off. Recurring monitoring of a person needs a documented purpose.
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Changes are reported as new or missing candidate URLs; a vanished account is not proof of anything.
